decisions.evidence: Putting the six comparisons together, all three mutagenic neighbors still look less like the query than their own mutagenic structures, because the query is consistently smaller, less lipophilic, less ring-rich, and more sp3-rich than those positive analogs. Across both sets, the query most often looks like the lower-exposure, less structurally elaborate scaffold, so the combined evidence supports option (A): is not mutagenic.
